title: GUI Manager — Frame Layout and Control Surface Design
description: Parent page frame layout with GUI Manager control surface. All dimensions percentage-based. Left and right panels start at 1%, can expand to push center content. Control frame is a 7% canvas that renders controls on demand via postMessage.

left_panel.behavior: Expands to push center content. Future: navigation, sidebar.
left_panel.notes: Allows entire interface to shift right at will.

chat_iframe.width: fills between left and right panels

control_frame.content: Empty canvas. Controls appear when needed (pagination, filters, future widgets). Blank otherwise.
control_frame.behavior: React app sends HTML via postMessage (gui:render). Parent renders into this div. Clicks relay back to React app via postMessage (gui:event). When controls are cleared (gui:clear), the canvas goes blank but stays visible at 7%.

right_panel.behavior: Expands when leaf page opens (architecture, roadmap, design docs). Retracts when closed.
right_panel.current_impl: legal-panel class — needs refactor from fixed overlay to inline flex panel

flow: 2. Tool counts total, returns first N records + total_count
3. Claude tells user: 'Here are the first N of TOTAL. Would you like to see more?'
4. NO controls yet. Client stores search state silently (pendingPaginationRef).
5. User says 'yes' (any message while pagination is pending)
6. Frontend fetches page 2 via /search directly — NO LLM round-trip
8. User pages forward/back via control buttons — all deterministic, no LLM
9. User sends new chat message — controls disappear, state cleared

button_states.back_at_beginning: Disabled, tooltip: 'You are at the beginning'
button_states.forward_at_end: Disabled, tooltip: 'You are at the end'

pagination.button_style: 3D raised buttons. Cold gray (blue-tinted) at rest. Warm gray (stone) when pressed. Mouse down depresses with inset shadow. Mouse up returns to raised.
pagination.api_endpoint: /search — direct provider search, no LLM, deterministic
rules: LLM never sees fetch_all or after_npi — those fields are not in the tool definition
LLM always gets total_count in tool result and must report it to user
System prompt RULE 9 tells Claude to present first page and ask 'would you like to see more?'
Controls only appear after user opts in and second page renders
All pagination after first page is deterministic — /search with after_npi, no LLM

gui_manager.state_ownership: All state lives in React. Parent page is a stateless rendering surface.

backlog.title: Leaf page control — more control over right panel behavior
backlog.notes: Boss directive: add to GUI Manager. Not further defined yet.

rules: All dimensions in percentages, no pixels
Left and right panels are always present (1% minimum)
Control frame is always visible at 7% — blank canvas when no controls active
Chat iframe fills remaining vertical space in center column
React app owns all state — parent page is a dumb rendering surface
Controls appear and disappear via postMessage — no page reloads
